---
title: "PCA diagram of Drosophila pseudomorpha transcriptome and proteome datasets"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
# 1.packages
library(bladderbatch)
library(sva)
library(ggplot2)
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(pheatmap) 
library(limma) 
library(ggsci)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggforce)

proj = "Dpse"
```
```{r}
# 1. transcriptome
library(readr)
library(tibble)

## sample information
pheno <- read_tsv("~/PMR/文章撰写/v2/00. new analysis/11.PCA/transcriptome_sample_info.txt")
pheno <- column_to_rownames(pheno, var = "sample")

## TPM value
exprSet <- read_csv("~/PMR/文章撰写/v2/00. new analysis/11.PCA/transcriptome.csv")
exprSet <- column_to_rownames(exprSet, var = "...1")
exprSet <- as.matrix(exprSet)
exprSet <- log2(exprSet + 1)

# 3.visualization
## A.boxplot--------------------------------------
mythe <- theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(),
                            panel.grid.minor=element_blank())
### dataframe for plotting
data <- data.frame(expression=c(exprSet),
                   sample=rep(colnames(exprSet),
                              each=nrow(exprSet)))
dim(data)

p <- ggplot(data = data, aes(x=sample, y=expression, fill=sample))
p1 <- p + geom_boxplot() +
  mythe +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) +
  xlab(NULL) + ylab("Expression of genes")
p1

## B.PCA analysis------------------------------------------------------
exp = t(exprSet) 
exp = as.data.frame(exp)
dim(exp)

ac <- data.frame(
  row.names = rownames(exp),
  Group = pheno$tissue,
  Stage = pheno$stage,
  Sex = pheno$sex   
)
stage_order <- c("Virgin", "6h post-mating", "12h post-mating")
ac$Stage <- factor(ac$Stage, levels = stage_order, ordered = TRUE)

pro = proj
this_title <- paste0(pro, '_transcriptome_PCA')

dat.pca <- PCA(exp, scale.unit = TRUE, graph = FALSE)
#summary(dat.pca)
#library(factoextra)
#eig.val <- get_eigenvalue(dat.pca)
#print(eig.val)

pca_data <- as.data.frame(dat.pca$ind$coord)
pca_data$Group <- ac$Group
pca_data$Stage <- ac$Stage
pca_data$Sex <- ac$Sex

my_colors <- c(
  "Testis" = "#A65440",      
  "Ovary" = "#905998",       
  "Head" = "#9A9A90",       
  "Accessory gland" = "#385B6F",          
  "FRT" = "#EBC855",         
  "Seminal vesicle" = "#5A9E6F",          
  "Spermatheca" = "#4B4B4B",
  "Whole body" = "#A8C4D1"
)

p2 <- ggplot(pca_data, aes(x = Dim.1, y = Dim.2, color = Group, size = Stage, shape = Sex)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17)) + 
  scale_size_manual(values = c(5, 6.5, 10)) + 
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) 
  ) +
  labs(title = this_title, x = "Dim1", y = "Dim2")

x_min <- min(pca_data$Dim.1) - 15
x_max <- max(pca_data$Dim.1) + 15
y_min <- min(pca_data$Dim.2) - 8
y_max <- max(pca_data$Dim.2) + 8
p2_fixed <- p2 + 
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(x_min, x_max), 
                  ylim = c(y_min, y_max))
p2_fixed

p2_zoom_clean <- p2_fixed + 
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-43, -23), ylim = c(-33, 20)) +
  labs(title = paste0(this_title, " (Zoomed Center)"))
p2_zoom_clean
```


```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "D:/Documents/PMR/文章撰写/v3/p2_fixed.pdf", 
  plot = p2_fixed, 
  width = 5,           # 宽度（默认单位为英寸）
  height = 3,          # 高度
  dpi = 300            # 分辨率
)

# 保存 p2_zoom_clean 为 PDF
ggsave(
  filename = "D:/Documents/PMR/文章撰写/v3/p2_zoom_clean.pdf", 
  plot = p2_zoom_clean, 
  width = 5, 
  height = 3, 
  dpi = 300
)
```
